span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE FIELD'S GOAL IS POSED AS A QUESTION AND THEN REPORTED TO HAVE NO AGREED FORM: will a program ever convert English text into a data structure that UNAMBIGUOUSLY AND COMPLETELY DESCRIBES THE MEANING - and AMONG NUMEROUS PROBLEMS, NO CONSENSUS HAS EMERGED ABOUT THE FORM OF SUCH A DATA STRUCTURE. The obstacle named first is not difficulty but the absence of agreement on what the answer would look like
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE FIELD'S TASKS ARE NAMED AS REDUCED OBJECTIVES ADOPTED BECAUSE THE REAL QUESTION IS UNRESOLVED: UNTIL SUCH FUNDAMENTAL PROBLEMS ARE RESOLVED, computer scientists MUST SETTLE FOR REDUCED OBJECTIVES - extracting SIMPLER REPRESENTATIONS describing RESTRICTED ASPECTS of the textual information. **What the field measures itself on is described as a substitute, in the paper's second sentence**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE SAME REPRESENTATIONS ARE GIVEN TWO DIFFERENT WARRANTS, AND ONE OF THEM IS A BELIEF: they are OFTEN MOTIVATED BY SPECIFIC APPLICATIONS, for instance bag-of-words for information retrieval - and they CAN ALSO BE MOTIVATED BY OUR BELIEF THAT THEY CAPTURE SOMETHING MORE GENERAL about natural language. An instrumental justification and an epistemic one, offered for the same objects
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE ANNOTATIONS EXIST IN ORDER TO MAKE SYSTEMS COMPARABLE, AND THE BENCHMARKS ARE CREDITED WITH DRIVING THE RESEARCH: text corpora HAVE BEEN MANUALLY ANNOTATED with such data structures IN ORDER TO COMPARE THE PERFORMANCE of various systems, and THE AVAILABILITY OF STANDARD BENCHMARKS HAS STIMULATED RESEARCH. The ground truth's purpose is comparison, and the comparison is what made the field move
span.note: about this quote: RE-SLICED, AND THE GUARD THAT CAUGHT IT WAS TWENTY MINUTES OLD. My end key was "...Natural Language Processing (NLP) and" - ending on "and" - because the page furniture ("Keywords: ... arXiv 1. Introduction") is spliced into that sentence and its real continuation is on the far side of the header. The Q-669 dangling-word check refused it at drafting time.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE METHOD IS DEFINED BY WHAT IT REFUSES TO USE, AND THE COST IS STATED IN THE SAME SENTENCE: the versatility is achieved BY TRYING TO AVOID TASK-SPECIFIC ENGINEERING AND THEREFORE DISREGARDING A LOT OF PRIOR KNOWLEDGE - Quotation withheld. What is given up is named as the price of what is gained
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE GROUND TRUTH ITSELF COMES IN TWO VOCABULARIES, AND THE FIX IS TO PICK ONE: the ground truth for three of the tasks IS PROVIDED USING TWO DIFFERENT TAGGING SCHEMES, and IN ORDER TO ELIMINATE THIS ADDITIONAL SOURCE OF VARIATIONS the authors DECIDED TO USE THE MOST EXPRESSIVE scheme FOR ALL TASKS. **Two naming systems for the same annotations, normalised by choosing the more expressive - not the more common**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE CHOICE OF HYPER-PARAMETERS IS CONCEDED TO BE ONE OF MANY EQUALLY GOOD ONES, WITH THE UNEXPLORED SPACE NAMED: although they ended up with A PARTICULAR CHOICE, MANY OTHER CHOICES ARE ALMOST EQUALLY AS GOOD - ALTHOUGH PERHAPS THERE ARE OTHERS THAT ARE BETTER, AS WE COULD NOT DO A FULL GRID SEARCH. The reported configuration is presented as a sample rather than an optimum
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE SCALE OF THE EXPERIMENT IS ATTRIBUTED TO THE HARDWARE RATHER THAN TO THE SCIENCE, WRYLY: very long training times MAKE SUCH STRATEGIES NECESSARY FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE - and IF WE HAD BEEN GIVEN COMPUTERS TEN TIMES FASTER, WE PROBABLY WOULD HAVE FOUND USES FOR DATASETS TEN TIMES BIGGER. The design is described as a function of the machines available
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: TWO NEGATIVE RESULTS FROM OTHER GROUPS ARE CITED SIDE BY SIDE: one group obtained results SOMEWHAT BELOW THE STATE-OF-THE-ART using joint decoding for two tasks, and another DESCRIBED A NEGATIVE RESULT AT THE SAME JOINT TASK. Failures are gathered as evidence about a practice rather than about the groups that attempted it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: avoiding task-specific features meant forgoing a large body of linguistic knowledge
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The system is only 'almost' from scratch: words are lowercased and capitalization encoded, and learning from letter sequences was left out of scope.
span.note: what this limits: the from-scratch claim: IDEALLY, AN EVEN MORE RAW INPUT WOULD BE TO LEARN FROM LETTER SEQUENCES RATHER THAN WORDS - words are lowercased and capitalisation encoded separately
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Week-long training times made a proper hyperparameter search infeasible.
span.note: what this limits: every hyperparameter-dependent result: TRAINING TIMES FOR SUCH LARGE SCALE SYSTEMS ARE COUNTED IN WEEKS, [SO] IT IS NOT FEASIBLE TO TRY MANY COMBINATIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Multi-task learning gave no or only marginal gains over separately trained per-task architectures.
span.note: what this limits: the multi-task claim: NO (OR ONLY MARGINAL) IMPROVEMENTS WERE OBTAINED with the unified architecture over separately trained ones
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The language model structure is probably too restrictive to capture hierarchical syntax; only the word embeddings are exploited downstream.
span.note: what this limits: any syntactic reading of the language model: ITS STRUCTURE IS PROBABLY TOO RESTRICTIVE FOR SUCH GOALS, and only the word embeddings are exploited
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The benchmark scores are treated as indirect measurements of something the paper does not measure directly, and the claim about it is a posit.
span.note: what this limits: the benchmark tables reported here: the authors view the benchmarks as indirect measurements of the relevance of the internal representations, and posit that those representations are more general than any of the benchmarks
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper names the failure mode its own design is exposed to.
span.note: what this limits: the comparison of these results against other systems: the authors note there is a great temptation to optimize a system's performance for a specific benchmark
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The pre-processing the architecture does keep is named, with a presumably attached to removing it.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that this system works from raw input: the authors state they did some pre-processing, namely lowercasing and encoding capitalization as a separate feature, and say that with enough unlabeled data they could presumably learn without it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Task-specific engineering is added back in a later section, so the headline architecture and the best numbers are not the same system.
span.note: what this limits: the best figures quoted from this paper: a later section evaluates how much further improvement comes from incorporating standard NLP task-specific engineering, which the main architecture avoids
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the word embedding dimension held constant at 50 across the tasks, so the language models of the earlier section could be reused unchanged
span.note: eliminates: a task-to-task difference that is really a difference in embedding capacity
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: performance also reported with the embeddings FROZEN during task-specific training, beside the figures where they are allowed to move
span.note: eliminates: attributing to the pre-trained embeddings a gain that actually comes from fine-tuning them on the task
